section_title: Mapping to the General Data Protection Regulation
chunk_text: Mapping of ISO/IEC 27701:2025 subclauses to GDPR articles. This mapping is indicative only. It is the organization's responsibility to assess its legal obligations and decide how to comply with them. Key mappings: Clause 4.1 (organizational context and dual role determination) maps to GDPR Articles 24, 25, 28, 32, 40, 41, 42. Clause 4.2 (interested parties) maps to GDPR Articles 31, 35, 36. Clause 4.3 (PIMS scope) and 4.4 (PIMS establishment) map to GDPR Article 32(2). Clause 5.2 (privacy policy) maps to GDPR Article 24(2). Clause 5.3 (roles and responsibilities) maps to GDPR Articles 27, 37, 38, 39. B.1.2.2 (identify and document purpose) maps to GDPR Articles 5(1)(b), 32(4). B.1.2.3 (identify lawful basis) maps to GDPR Articles 6, 8, 9, 17. B.1.2.4 (consent timing) maps to GDPR Articles 8(1), 8(2). B.1.2.5 (obtain and record consent) maps to GDPR Articles 7(1), 7(2), 9(2)(a). B.1.2.6 (privacy impact assessment) maps to GDPR Articles 35, 36. B.1.2.7 (contracts with PII processors) maps to GDPR Articles 5(2), 28(3)(e), 28(9). B.1.2.8 (joint PII controller) maps to GDPR Articles 26(1), 26(2), 26(3). B.1.2.9 (records related to processing PII) maps to GDPR Articles 5(2), 24(1), 30. B.1.3.3 (information for PII principals) maps to GDPR Articles 11(2), 12(1), 13, 14, 15. B.1.3.5 (modify or withdraw consent) maps to GDPR Articles 7(3), 13(2)(c), 14(2)(d), 18. B.1.3.7 (access, correction or erasure) maps to GDPR Articles 5(1)(d), 13(2)(b), 14(2)(c), 16, 17. B.1.3.9 (providing copy of PII) maps to GDPR Articles 15(3), 15(4), 20. B.1.4.2 (limit collection) maps to GDPR Articles 5(1)(b), 5(1)(c). B.1.4.8 (retention) maps to GDPR Articles 13(2)(a), 14(2)(a). B.1.5.2 (PII transfer between jurisdictions) maps to GDPR Articles 15(2), 44-49. B.3.10 (supplier agreements) maps to GDPR Articles 5(1)(f), 28(1), 28(3). B.3.11 (incident management) maps to GDPR Articles 5(1)(f), 33, 34. B.3.12 (incident response) maps to GDPR Articles 33, 34. B.2.2.2 (customer agreement for processors) maps to GDPR Articles 28(3)(f), 28(9), 35(1). B.2.5.2 (basis for transfer between jurisdictions) maps to GDPR Articles 44-49. B.2.5.5 (notification of disclosure requests) maps to GDPR Article 28(3)(a). B.2.5.7 (disclosure of subcontractors) maps to GDPR Articles 28(2), 28(4). B.2.5.8 (engagement of subcontractor) maps to GDPR Articles 28(2), 28(3)(d).

Mapping of ISO/IEC 27701:2025 to ISO/IEC 27018 (Guidelines for protection of PII in public clouds acting as PII processors) and ISO/IEC 29151 (Code of practice for PII protection). Correspondence between controls in ISO/IEC 27701:2025 and controls in ISO/IEC 27701:2019. This second edition cancels and replaces the first edition (ISO/IEC 27701:2019) which has been technically revised. The main change is that the document has been redrafted as a stand-alone management system standard. Key correspondences: A.3.3 (Policies for information security) corresponds to 2019 controls 6.2.1.1 and 6.2.1.2. A.3.4 (Information security roles and responsibilities) corresponds to 2019 control 6.3.1.1. A.3.5 (Classification of information) corresponds to 2019 control 6.5.2.1. A.3.8 (Identity management) corresponds to 2019 control 6.6.2.1. A.3.9 (Access rights) corresponds to 2019 controls 6.6.2.2, 6.6.2.5, 6.6.2.6. A.3.16 (Compliance with policies) corresponds to 2019 controls 6.15.2.2, 6.15.2.3. A.3.17 (Awareness, education and training) corresponds to 2019 control 6.4.2.2. A.3.18 (Confidentiality agreements) corresponds to 2019 control 6.10.2.4. A.3.19 (Clear desk and clear screen) corresponds to 2019 control 6.8.2.9. A.3.20 (Storage media) corresponds to 2019 controls 6.5.3.1, 6.5.3.2, 6.5.3.3. A.3.21 (Secure disposal) corresponds to 2019 control 6.8.2.7. A.3.22 (User endpoint devices) corresponds to 2019 controls 6.3.2.1, 6.8.2.8. A.3.23 (Secure authentication) corresponds to 2019 control 6.6.4.2. A.3.24 (Information backup) corresponds to 2019 control 6.9.3.1. A.3.25 (Logging) corresponds to 2019 controls 6.9.4.1, 6.9.4.2, 6.9.4.3. A.3.26 (Cryptography) corresponds to 2019 controls 6.7.1.1, 6.7.1.2. A.3.27 (Secure development life cycle) corresponds to 2019 control 6.11.2.1. A.3.28 (Application security) corresponds to 2019 controls 6.11.1.2, 6.11.1.3. A.3.29 (Secure system architecture) corresponds to 2019 control 6.11.2.5. Controls new in 2025 edition not present in 2019: information deletion, data masking, data leakage prevention, monitoring activities, web filtering, secure coding, configuration management, ICT readiness for business continuity, physical security monitoring.
